events.name: Kaiju Tentacruel
events.intro:
*A pier folds in half.*

*Boats slide down it like plates off a table. People run past you, inland. A harbour bell rings and rings, and then stops, because the tower it was in isn't there.*

*Out in the bay, something lifts a crane out of the water, looks at it, and puts it down on a warehouse.*

It is a Tentacruel. It is the size of a ferry. Nobody Dynamaxed it: it grew, year on year, on what the harbour poured into the bay.

**Harbourmaster, Captain Ffion:** "It came up at dawn. It's not attacking. It's *looking* for something. It just doesn't care what's in the way."

**Ffion:** "I've boats that'll help. I've trainers stuck on the breakwater. I've a town. Pick what you save first."

success.text:
Ffion puts two fingers in her mouth and whistles. Three trawlers swing their bows round at once.

"They'll worry it every time it shields up. That's all they can do. It's enough."

effects.text: **Ffion:** "You again. Good. You're calm around big ones."

success.text:
You run toward the water while everyone else runs away from it.

Ffion shouts something after you. The wind takes most of it. The last word is "careful".

effects.text: **Ffion:** "You again. Good. You're calm around big ones."

events.name: The Harbour
events.intro:
Tentacool swarm in the shallows, hundreds of them, pale as jelly. Four people are stranded on what is left of the breakwater.

**Swimmer Bettany** treads water by a broken post, furious. **Old Ned** sits on a rock, still holding his rod. Further along, **a Sailor** and his Machop hold a mooring line, and **a small girl** with a Psyduck is pointing at the reef.

The tide gives you four turns before the swarm closes. A Water- or Flying-type gets someone off in one. Anyone else takes two.

choices.label: Get Swimmer Bettany off the post.

branches.text: Your Pokémon reaches her in one go. Bettany climbs out, spits seawater, and says, "I was doing *lengths*." She wants a go at it.
Your Pokémon reaches her in one go. Bettany climbs out, spits seawater, and says, "I was doing *lengths*." She wants a go at it.

success.text: It takes two tries through the swarm. Bettany climbs out, spits seawater, and says, "I was doing *lengths*." She wants a go at it.

choices.label: Reach Old Ned on his rock.

branches.text: Ned steps across like he's getting off a bus. "Took your time." He hasn't let go of the rod. He says he can hook one of those out of a fight.
Ned steps across like he's getting off a bus. "Took your time." He hasn't let go of the rod. He says he can hook one of those out of a fight.

success.text: Two slow trips through the stinging water. Ned steps across like he's getting off a bus. "Took your time." He says he can hook one of those out of a fight.
You pick your way along the broken stones, toward the Sailor and the girl.

The tide turns. The swarm closes on the breakwater all at once.

Whoever is still out there will have to hold on. You turn to face the Tentacool.

events.name: The Far End of the Breakwater
events.intro:
The Sailor has wrapped the mooring line twice round his arm. His Machop holds the other end in its teeth, eyes shut, jaw set. The boat on the line is the last one still floating.

Past him, the small girl sits cross-legged with her Psyduck. She isn't frightened. She is pointing at the reef, and has been, the whole time.

choices.label: Help the Sailor and his Machop.

branches.text: Your Pokémon takes the line. The Machop lets go for the first time in an hour and sits down hard. The Sailor says it can brace a pylon if you need one dropped.
Your Pokémon takes the line. The Machop lets go for the first time in an hour and sits down hard. The Sailor says it can brace a pylon if you need one dropped.

success.text: Two turns of hauling, side by side with the Machop. It lets go for the first time in an hour. The Sailor says it can brace a pylon if you need one dropped.

choices.label: Carry the girl and her Psyduck back.

branches.text: She holds the Psyduck very tightly and keeps her eyes on the reef the whole way. "It keeps looking at the same place," she says. "There. Look."
She holds the Psyduck very tightly and keeps her eyes on the reef the whole way. "It keeps looking at the same place," she says. "There. Look."

success.text: It takes two turns. She holds the Psyduck very tightly and keeps her eyes on the reef. "It keeps looking at the same place," she says. "There. Look."
You pick your way back to the others.

events.name: The Swarm
events.intro: The Tentacool come up the stones in a wave, stinging, glassy, and a long way from calm.

success.text: Old Ned casts once, long and lazy. A Tentacool sails out of the swarm on the end of his line. "One fewer," he says. The rest come at you.
Two of them reach the top of the stones together.

events.name: The Sea Wall
events.intro:
It reaches the sea wall. Pylons and cranes stand along it, four of them, leaning in the wind.

It drags one arm along the wall, feeling for something. It doesn't look at the town at all.

**Ffion:** "Drop one on it! It'll stop it a breath. It'll also make it angry. Your call."

success.text:
Your Pokémon hits the footing. The pylon groans, tips, and comes down across its arms.

It stops, stunned, for one breath. When it moves again, it moves faster, and it is angry now.

effects.text: The Sailor's Machop braces the pylon with its shoulder. The stun holds for two breaths.

branches.text: You leave the pylons standing. It leaves the wall behind, calm, still looking. You follow it toward the reef.

success.text: It leaves the wall behind. You follow it along the shore toward the reef.

events.name: The Reef
events.intro:
*It stops. It turns its back on the town. It lowers itself over one patch of reef, and it doesn't move from it.*

*It isn't attacking anything now. It's guarding.*

Under it, caught in a net, is a Tentacool. Small. Hurt. The net's float has a factory stamp on it.

success.text:
One of your Pokémon goes for the net. The rest stand between it and the Kaiju, which panics, swinging blind, because something is near its little one.

Two turns. That is how long the cords will take. Hold it off for two turns.

You step out onto the reef. It rises to meet you, and the bay rises with it.

Three shield bars glow across its body. Out in the shallows, the Tentacool gather to its call.

choices.label: Take the float with the stamp.

success.text:
You wade out and pull the float free of the cords. Under the weed, pressed into the plastic:

*"PROPERTY OF COASTLINE BALL WORKS"*

Somebody made this net, and somebody lost it, and somebody's factory is still pouring into the bay.

events.name: The Small One
events.intro:
*The Kaiju goes still the moment the net falls away. It lifts the small one in two tentacles. It looks at you for a long time.*

Then it sets the small one down in the shallows at your feet, and waits.

success.text:
The cords part. The net falls away. The small Tentacool drifts to you. Behind it, the Kaiju lowers itself, slowly, into the bay, watching the whole way down.

It is the one from the net. It stays.

effects.text: **The girl with the Psyduck:** "I said. I said it was looking."
The Kaiju Tentacruel lifted its little one out of the net, looked at you for a long time, and let it go with you.

choices.label: Take the float with the stamp.

success.text:
The float is still in the cut net. Under the weed:

*"PROPERTY OF COASTLINE BALL WORKS"*

Somebody made this net, and somebody lost it, and somebody's factory is still pouring into the bay.

Ffion watches the bay close over it. "Right," she says. "Pier first."

Later, they rebuild the pier with a gap in it, for something to swim through.

events.name: It Sinks
events.intro:
The last shield breaks. It sinks, slowly, and drags itself off the reef. It does not go far. It stays in the deep water, watching the net.

The small one's still caught. Someone wades out with a knife and cuts it free, and it swims, crooked, to the big shape waiting in the dark.

choices.label: Take the float with the stamp.

success.text:
The float is still tangled in the cut net. Under the weed:

*"PROPERTY OF COASTLINE BALL WORKS"*

Somebody made this net, and somebody lost it, and somebody's factory is still pouring into the bay.

Ffion looks at the wreck of her pier for a while. "It wasn't after us," she says. "I know that. Doesn't help."

Later, they rebuild the pier with a gap in it, for something to swim through.

events.name: It Retreats
events.intro:
It turns from the reef, past the breakwater, out into the bay, and the harbour market slams its shutters for the day.

When the water settles, the girl with the Psyduck and Old Ned wade out to the reef together. Ned has a bread knife. They cut the small one free, and the Kaiju takes it, and goes.

You get nothing. The town is still standing.

success.text: Ffion claps you on the shoulder as you pass. She doesn't say anything. She doesn't have to.

events.name: Something Rises
events.intro:
A trawler with no name painted on it is dragging a net through the shallows. The net is full of Tentacool.

Two crewmen see you watching. They don't like being watched. They let their Pokémon out.

success.text:
You step onto the jetty. Behind you, the water bulges.

*A tentacle the size of a mast rises out of the bay and lays itself, gently, beside your Pokémon. It remembers you.*

win.text: The Kaiju Tentacruel rose out of the sea to fight beside you.

success.text: You walk on. Out in the bay, something very large follows the trawler, just under the surface.

events.name: The Harbour, Again
events.intro:
The bay runs the colour of the factory's last night. A harbour bell is ringing, and this time nobody stops to look.

*Out past the breakwater, something rises. You know its shape. It does not look at the reef. It does not look at anything.*

It let you take its little one, and then the water went bad again. It has come back to the harbour, and this time it isn't looking for anything.

success.text:
You stand on the sea wall. It sees you. For a moment it stops, and you think it remembers.

Then it comes on.

win.text: The Kaiju came back angry, because the factory was still running. You held the sea wall.

choices.label: Get people off the quay instead.

success.text:
You do not fight it. You run along the quay shouting, and people run, and the stalls go over behind them.

It takes the pier again, and a warehouse, and goes. Nobody is hurt. The market will not open today.

events.name: Maiden's Peak
events.intro:
A cliff town, all stairs and lanterns. It is festival week. The old woman selling tea says it is always festival week.

Above the market, at the far end of a street, a woman in a veil is walking away. She does not hurry. She does not look back.

success.text: The crowd takes you in. Somewhere ahead, a lantern turns a corner.
You keep to the road. Behind you, festival music, and one lantern, high up, that does not move with the wind.

events.name: Maiden's Peak: The Market
events.intro:
Lantern Row and the TM Hall open off the square. Further in: Swap Alley, Egg Row, the stalls, the dusk lanes, the Tea House.

At the end of Lantern Row, a veil turns a corner.

success.text: Paper lanterns overhead, shelves of medicine underneath. Everything costs a little more here.
A long hall of glass cases. The board by the door has changed again.
You push deeper in.
You leave the stalls behind and run.

success.text: Traders call from every doorway.
Baskets of warm eggs and a very old man with a very serious face.

events.name: Egg Row
events.intro:
Mystery eggs in straw. A warm-sand hatchery. Egg traders. And the Egg Move Tutor, who teaches one egg move a visit and charges by how rare it is.

Above the row, on a stone bridge, somebody laughs.

events.name: Route 25: The Third
events.intro:
The third has something clutched to its chest. A Berry. One of theirs.

It hasn't eaten it. It's been saving it.

success.text: Halfway through, it eats the Berry. It looks almost ashamed.

events.name: Route 25: One Breath
events.intro:
Three are down. The fourth hangs back, just for a moment, to look at them.

It's the only breath you'll get.

success.text: You crouch with your team and breathe. It isn't much.

events.name: Route 25: The Fourth
events.intro: The fourth watched the others fall. It isn't screaming any more. It comes in quiet, low and fast, aiming for the legs.

success.text: A Low Kick, then another. It learned that from somewhere.

events.name: Route 25: The Fifth
events.intro:
The four crawl back behind it. The fifth hasn't moved since the start.

*It stands in front of them, with its arms out.*

It doesn't attack. It's waiting to see what you do.

success.text: It doesn't move out of the way. It doesn't attack. It stands in front of the others with its arms out, and waits to see what you do.

It doesn't move out of the way. It doesn't attack. It stands in front of the others with its arms out, and waits to see what you do.

It looks at your face, for a long time. It's seen that look before. You gave a starving Poochyena your lunch once, and it shows.

It doesn't move out of the way. It doesn't attack. It stands in front of the others with its arms out, and waits to see what you do.

It looks at your face, for a long time. It's seen that look before. You rolled a stolen Egg back to its parents once, and it shows.

events.name: Route 25: The Fifth
events.intro:
The gauntlet doesn't happen.

*The fifth walks out onto the road, alone. It looks at the sack. It looks at you.*

*It bows.*

success.text: Behind it, in the trees, four thin Mankey are already eating.

events.name: Route 25: Driven Back
events.intro: Your team goes down. The Mankey don't chase you. They just stand on the road until you're gone.

success.text: Nobody joins you. Behind you, the screaming starts again, and then stops.

events.name: Route 25: One of the Troop
events.intro:
The road's quiet. The troop is looking at you.

One Mankey steps out. It doesn't ask. It just stands next to your bag, the way the fifth stood in front of the four.

success.text: It falls in beside you. It already knows Swords Dance and Mach Punch, from somewhere.

effects.text: The four lie where they fell. The fifth, beaten, still drags itself in front of them. It's one of the four that comes. The fifth never joins anyone who hit it first.
It's the fifth. It doesn't look back at the others. It knows they'll eat tonight.
Bond +2: it has seen you bring the food home.

success.text: You shake your head. It goes back to the others. They make room for it.

events.name: The Berry Grove
events.intro:
A Berry grove, fenced with string and tin cans. Three trainers are sitting on the fence. You know them.

**A trainer:** "We guard it now. From people like us." They look embarrassed. "The Mankey come by for the windfalls."

success.text: Someone's coming through the trees with an empty sack.
They wave back. One of them is wearing a Mankey-fur hat, and looks very sorry about it.

events.name: Route 25: The Angry Mankey
events.intro:
*A screech. Then four more. The trees shake.*

*Five Mankey drop onto the road. Four are jumping, shrieking, beating the ground.*

*The fifth is standing still, in front of the other four, with its arms out.*

success.text: You put your bag down and stand your ground. The four stop jumping. They come.

choices.label: Find out why they're so angry.

success.text: You back away slowly, off the road. Behind the trees, there's smoke, and a trail of Berry rinds.
